rules.description: Air density used when the user does not supply one (20 degC, 101.325 kPa, dry air).
rules.sourceReference: ISO 2533 / ideal gas law, dry air at 293.15 K and 101325 Pa

rules.description: Tip speed above which a noise/stress caution is raised for industrial axial fans.
rules.sourceReference: Typical industrial axial fan practice; ASHRAE Handbook - HVAC Systems and Equipment, Fans chapter (noise and tip speed guidance)

rules.description: Tip speed above which the design is outside the validated envelope and CAD generation is blocked.
rules.sourceReference: Validated envelope of this calculator; structural and compressibility limits require a specialist design beyond this range

rules.description: Recommended hub-to-tip ratio selected by fan static pressure. Higher pressure needs a larger hub.
rules.sourceReference: Typical axial fan design practice (low pressure 0.3-0.4, medium 0.4-0.6, high 0.6-0.75); Eck, Fans; Wright, Fluid Machinery

rules.description: Allowed hub-to-tip ratio range for this calculator.
rules.sourceReference: Validated envelope of this calculator; typical axial fan practice

rules.description: Recommended blade count selected by hub-to-tip ratio.
rules.sourceReference: Typical axial fan practice (fewer blades at low hub ratio, more blades at high hub ratio); Eck, Fans

rules.description: Allowed blade count range.
rules.sourceReference: Validated envelope of this calculator

rules.description: Design flow coefficient phi = axial velocity / tip speed, used to size the impeller diameter.
rules.sourceReference: Axial fan non-dimensional design practice (flow coefficient 0.1-0.5); Wright, Fluid Machinery; Cordier line

rules.description: Allowed flow coefficient range.
rules.sourceReference: Typical axial fan operating range; Wright, Fluid Machinery

rules.description: Recommended static pressure coefficient psi_s = static pressure / (0.5 * rho * tip speed^2).
rules.sourceReference: Typical axial fan non-dimensional performance range; Eck, Fans

rules.description: Hydraulic efficiency assumed to convert total pressure rise into blade work (Euler head) when sizing blade angles.
rules.sourceReference: Typical axial fan hydraulic efficiency 0.80-0.90; Wright, Fluid Machinery

rules.description: Static efficiency assumed for shaft power estimate when the user does not supply one.
rules.sourceReference: Typical industrial axial fan static efficiency 0.45-0.65

rules.description: Allowed static efficiency range for user-supplied values.
rules.sourceReference: Validated envelope of this calculator

rules.description: Radial tip clearance as a fraction of tip diameter.
rules.sourceReference: Typical axial fan tip clearance 0.3-1.0 percent of diameter; AMCA 801 / manufacturer practice

rules.description: Minimum radial tip clearance for manufacturability.
rules.sourceReference: Manufacturing practice for fabricated casings

rules.description: Casing wall thickness as a fraction of casing inner diameter.
rules.sourceReference: Fabricated sheet-metal casing practice (to be confirmed per material)

rules.description: Minimum casing wall thickness.

rules.description: Casing axial length as a multiple of tip diameter for a tube-axial arrangement.
rules.sourceReference: Typical tube-axial fan proportions (0.4-0.6 x diameter)

rules.description: Allowed blade pitch (stagger) angle range, measured from the plane of rotation.

rules.description: Tip diameter range supported by this calculator.
